name: salsa-lint-tools
description: Isolated ESLint toolchain for Salsa. typescript-eslint needs the TypeScript 5.x/6.0 JS API, which the repo's TypeScript 7 (native) no longer ships, so lint gets its own node_modules with typescript 5.9. Installed by `npm run lint:install`; see docs/dev/checks-and-ci.md.
